If you're visiting Thailand and want to see elephants, I highly recommend this place! All activities are elephant-friendly!

Advantages:
1. You can tell the staff have a good relationship with the elephants (because the accommodation is right next to the elephants, and the environment is similar to theirs).
2. Although there are only two elephants, there's absolutely no animal droppings smell.
3. They always take videos and photos first, so you can see them before deciding whether to buy anything. I personally think it's a great deal when bundled with souvenirs. Their photography skills are good.
4. The package activities are really fun, and they don't force the elephants at all.
5. The staff are very friendly.

Disadvantages:
1. The package activities are a bit short (maybe they don't want the elephants to be constantly disturbed).
2. The park is rather small, with only two elephants.
3. The souvenir is an elephant-themed notebook, but it's not very easy to write in. I personally loved it, but my travel companion was very confused; it's definitely not very practical.
